caption: The drawing consists of an arrangement of large, detailed flowers and leaves in the foreground against a patterned background. The flowers have multiple layers of rounded, scalloped petals, primarily colored in cream and pale pink with red accents and brown shading, with one prominent flower featuring a star-like center. Smaller blue flowers appear interspersed among the larger blooms. The leaves are rendered in hues of blue and brown, with curved veins and tips, branching outwards from the center cluster. The background features a crisscross diamond lattice pattern formed by intertwining beige and brown lines over a red base, giving the appearance of a woven or textured surface. The composition is balanced with the floral cluster concentrated mainly toward the center and slightly to the lower left, while the leaves and lattice extend to the edges of the square frame.
